blocks.name: Foundry Nodes
blocks.description: Executable worker services that process Workitems inside a Flow. Nodes implement creation, validation, review, refinement, governance, HITL, integration, or domain logic while the runtime controls routing and state.

blocks.name: Foundry Node SDK
blocks.description: Developer toolkit used to build Foundry Nodes. It provides assignment-scoped APIs for artefacts, feedback, laws, Workitems, telemetry, routing, HITL queues, and agent execution through Sidecar-mediated runtime calls.

blocks.name: Model Provider
blocks.description: Inference system used by LLM-backed nodes such as Forge, Appraise, Refine, Juror, or other FoundryAgent-based nodes.

blocks.name: Observability Stack
blocks.description: External metrics and log/audit pipeline that receives Prometheus metrics and JSON Lines audit events from Flow Monitor.

blocks.name: Source Control System
blocks.description: Stores Flow configuration, node code, support service code, manifests, and policy changes owned by the Flow Engineering Team.

blocks.name: Kubernetes Cluster
blocks.description: Runtime substrate hosting Flow namespaces, CRDs, pods, services, secrets, storage, networking, and the Flow Operator.

blocks.name: Foundry Flow Runtime
blocks.description: Governed workflow runtime that executes Flows, routes Workitems, enforces contracts, records artefact provenance, manages laws, emits telemetry, and tracks friction.

blocks.name: Flow Governor
blocks.description: Oversees viability and governance cost. Uses friction, telemetry, audit, throughput, and cost signals to decide whether policy, topology, scaling, or operating constraints need change.

blocks.name: Foundry Administrator
blocks.description: Operates the Foundry platform infrastructure across one or more Flows: Kubernetes, CRDs, Operators, platform services, observability, access, backup, and recovery.

blocks.name: Flow Engineering Team
blocks.description: Defines, builds, and maintains a Flow’s topology and behaviour: nodes, routing, contracts, capabilities, stamps, support services, integrations, and Tier 3-or-below statutes.

blocks.name: Foundry Dashboard
blocks.description: Human-facing application for Flow visibility, work interaction, operational views, HITL decisions, and governance/friction reporting.

blocks.name: Identity Provider
blocks.description: OIDC identity provider, such as Microsoft Entra ID, that authenticates dashboard users and service access.

blocks.name: Foundry CLI
blocks.description: Command-line tool for installing, configuring, inspecting, and operating Foundry Flows through kubeconfig/client-go Kubernetes access. Permissions are determined by Kubernetes RBAC.

blocks.name: Flow Operator
blocks.description: Kubernetes control-plane controller that reconciles Foundry Flow CRDs, creates runtime resources, and manages lifecycle/status.

blocks.name: Runtime Sidecar
blocks.description: Co-located per-node proxy and runtime host that mediates node protocol calls, identity, telemetry, and access to runtime services.

blocks.name: Event Bus Service
blocks.description: Internal pub/sub transport for Flow events, node lifecycle events, governance signals, and coordination messages.

blocks.name: Friction Ledger Service
blocks.description: Records friction, cost, and audit signals produced by runtime activity and governance decisions.

blocks.name: Flow Monitor Service
blocks.description: Observes Flow state, node progress, failures, deadlocks, thresholds, and emits operational or governance signals.

blocks.name: Librarian Service
blocks.description: Manages active Flow knowledge, state, artifact lookup, and execution context needed during runtime operation.

blocks.name: Archivist Service
blocks.description: Persists completed or historical Flow records, artifacts, and audit trails for later inspection.

blocks.name: Node Application Container
blocks.description: Selected standard or custom node binary built from a node image; implements node behaviour, prompts, integrations, validation, and Workitem handling.

blocks.name: SDK Runtime Client
blocks.description: Go SDK client that connects node code to the in-pod Runtime Sidecar and, when configured, directly to the Event Bus for streaming operations.

blocks.name: SDK Node Server
blocks.description: Go SDK gRPC server entry point that exposes NodeService.Process and invokes user-provided node handlers.

blocks.name: Agent Framework
blocks.description: Managed inference wrapper for LLM-backed nodes, including prompt rendering, heartbeat lifecycle, schema validation, retries, and cost telemetry.

blocks.name: Provider Abstraction
blocks.description: Inference provider interface and adapters that isolate node logic from model-provider-specific request and cost details.

blocks.name: Domain Model APIs
blocks.description: Typed SDK objects and helpers for Workitems, Flow topology, Nodes, Laws, Artefacts, Feedback, capabilities, and child work.

blocks.name: HITL Queue API
blocks.description: Optional SDK queue manager and REST/gRPC API for human-in-the-loop queue listing, claiming, decisions, release, and peer coordination.

blocks.name: CLI Command Layer
blocks.description: Parses flowctl commands and flags, then invokes watch, package, install, and init workflows.

blocks.name: Flow Package Manager
blocks.description: Packages, normalizes, rewrites, validates, and installs Flow manifests and archives for Kubernetes deployment.

blocks.name: Kubernetes Client
blocks.description: client-go/controller-runtime access layer that loads kubeconfig, watches Foundry CRDs, lists namespaces/pods, and applies resources subject to Kubernetes RBAC.

blocks.name: Port Forward Manager
blocks.description: Manages client-go SPDY port-forwards to Flow pods and services for local diagnostic and HITL access.

blocks.name: Runtime Service Clients
blocks.description: gRPC/HTTP clients for runtime-facing operations such as Archivist artefact/feedback access and HITL queue actions through local forwards.

blocks.name: Terminal UI
blocks.description: Bubble Tea interactive Workitem browser for Flow state, topology, artefacts, HITL decisions, deletion, creation, status, and namespace views.

blocks.name: Kubernetes API Server
blocks.description: Cluster control-plane API used by administrators, flowctl, operators, and controllers to read, watch, create, update, and delete Kubernetes and Foundry resources.

blocks.name: Kubernetes RBAC and Authn/Authz
blocks.description: Kubernetes authentication and authorization layer that evaluates user and service-account permissions for API requests.

blocks.name: Foundry CRD Store
blocks.description: Kubernetes custom resources for FoundryFlow, FoundryNode, Workitem, GovernedArtefact, Law, LawGroup, Treaty, and related runtime state.

blocks.name: Workload Orchestration
blocks.description: Kubernetes scheduling and controller machinery that runs operator, runtime service, sidecar, node, and dashboard pods.

blocks.name: Flow Namespaces
blocks.description: Per-Flow Kubernetes namespaces that isolate Flow runtime resources, node pods, service accounts, config, and status objects.

blocks.name: Persistent Storage
blocks.description: Kubernetes-backed persistent volumes and storage classes used by runtime services for durable Flow state, artifacts, audit records, and ledgers.

blocks.name: Dashboard Web UI
blocks.description: Browser-based user interface for Flow visibility, work interaction, topology evidence, governance outcomes, HITL decisions, and operational views.

blocks.name: Dashboard BFF/API
blocks.description: Backend-for-frontend service that serves dashboard APIs, enforces authenticated user context, coordinates runtime reads/actions, and correlates human decisions with audit evidence.

blocks.name: Auth and Session Module
blocks.description: Dashboard authentication/session boundary that integrates with the external Identity Provider and propagates user identity to dashboard workflows.

blocks.name: Runtime Data Client
blocks.description: Dashboard backend client layer for reading Flow state, Workitems, artefacts, feedback, laws, telemetry, and operational status from runtime and Kubernetes-facing APIs.

blocks.name: HITL Assignment Store
blocks.description: Dashboard-owned store for human assignment mapping, claim ownership, and decision identity correlation; HITL nodes keep only queue parking state.

blocks.name: Governance Reporting Views
blocks.description: Dashboard reporting surface for friction, throughput, failures, audit evidence, policy pressure, and governance cost trends.

blocks.name: Prometheus
blocks.description: Native metrics backend supported by Foundry for scraping and storing runtime, Kubernetes, and service metrics.

blocks.name: Grafana
blocks.description: Native dashboarding surface supported by Foundry for visualising metrics, friction, throughput, failures, and operational health.

blocks.name: OpenTelemetry Collector
blocks.description: Native telemetry collection path supported by Foundry for receiving, processing, and exporting traces, metrics, and logs.

blocks.name: JSONL Stdout Output
blocks.description: Structured JSONL log output written to container stdout for consumption by cluster log collectors such as Logstash, Fluent Bit, or equivalent pipelines.

blocks.name: Cartographer Service
blocks.description: Core Flow system service that provides a typed, queryable active knowledge graph backed by an in-process LadybugDB engine persisted to a Kubernetes PVC. It stores entities, edges, text, and vector-searchable context according to schema declared in the Flow CRD.
